For all PACC majors admitted to Senior Year places Not for students who have taken ACCT2151, LAWS1041 or LAWS1042 Enrollment Requirements Class Attributes English only Class Availability Class Capacity 77 Wait List Capacity 999 Enrollment Total 7 Wait List Total 0 Available Seats 70 Description This course will provide an introduction to the legal system of Hong Kong with emphasis on the legal environment of business. It will encompass a study of selected topics in contract law including the elements of business contracting, the rights and obligations of parties to the contract, the sale of goods and employment law. This course will also examine the tort of negligence in a professional context. Return to Teaching Timetable
